title: ChiProgramBench: Can LLM Agents Rebuild Efficient Circuits from Pin-Level Experiments?
abstract: arXiv:2611.31082v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Understanding a system that can be run but not inspected is a core engineering skill: one designs experiments, forms hypotheses about hidden state and timing, discards those that observations refute, and finally builds a replacement that works and is efficient. To evaluate this capability of LLM agents in the hardware domain, we present ChiProgramBench, 18 tasks derived from open-source processors, accelerators, codecs, transforms, interconnects, and control circuits. Agents can only drive and read the pins of a hidden, stateful simulated reference, then submit a gate-level netlist made of public library cells. Agents work in two settings: black-box discovery gives only anonymized functional pins and the interfaces of fixed memories, while function-guided reconstruction adds the circuit's purpose and each pin's role. translated_title: ChiProgramBench：LLM智能体能否通过引脚级实验重建高效电路？
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.31082v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：理解一个可以运行但无法查看内部的系统是一项核心工程技能：人们需要设计实验、对隐藏的状态和时序形成假设、丢弃被观测结果反驳的假设，并最终构建一个既能工作又高效的替代品。为了评估LLM智能体在硬件领域的这一能力，我们提出了ChiProgramBench，其中包含18个源自开源处理器、加速器、编解码器、变换电路、互连电路和控制电路的任务。智能体只能驱动和读取一个隐藏的、有状态的模拟参考电路的引脚，然后提交由公开库单元构成的门级网表。智能体在两种设置下工作：黑盒发现模式仅提供匿名化的功能引脚和固定存储器的接口；而功能引导重建模式则额外提供电路的用途和每个引脚的角色。隐藏的测试用例将智能体的输出与参考电路逐周期进行比较；功耗、延迟和面积则相对于参考电路获得相应评分。
tldr: 该论文提出了ChiProgramBench基准，通过18个源自真实开源硬件的任务，评估LLM智能体仅凭引脚探测实验推断隐藏电路功能并重建高效门级网表的硬件逆向工程能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ChiProgramBench, a benchmark of 18 hardware reverse-engineering tasks that evaluates whether LLM agents can infer and efficiently rebuild hidden circuits solely through pin-level probing experiments.
